title: Ordinary open-closed localization in the fixed constant coefficient coordinates
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, Base b and Operations o as in def-sp-tower-shriek-data. Let i:Z -> T be a closed immersion and a:U -> T a complementary quasi-compact open immersion. On the ordinary abelian category S(ell,E,T) of strict coefficient systems, the closed functor (o.geometry i).push preserves finite colimits. For every system M, the actual counit of (o.openOp a).ordinaryAdjunction followed by the actual unit of (o.geometry i).ordinaryAdjunction is short exact: the counit is monic, the unit epic, their composite is zero, and their image and kernel agree. There are no derived objects, representative choices, or boundary morphisms in this conclusion.

source.place: paragraph (2), ordinary counit-unit exact sequence before passage to complexes

proof.text: Apply the proved source-library shortExact_openClosedShortComplex over the constant finite ring R_n. Transport the sequence through sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence using exactness of equivalences. Uniqueness of left adjoints and their unit/counit equations identify the conjugated sequence with the finiteOpenAdjunction counit and canonical constant-ring closed unit. Only the normalized ordinary pullback comparison from lem-trf-open-square-exchange is used, not its square-exchange or derived assertions.

Conjugate the proved finite-colimit preservation of closed lowerStar. The ordinary pullback comparison identifies its left adjoint with the canonical constant-ring pullback; uniqueness of right adjoints therefore identifies the conjugated direct image with the canonical constant-ring pushforward.

For each index n, Open.counit_evaluation identifies the evaluated open counit up to the specified evaluation isomorphisms. geometry_unit_evaluation identifies the evaluated closed unit. Transport the finite short exact sequence through these isomorphisms.

Evaluation functors are exact and jointly faithful: equality of each evaluated map is equality on every pair (n,V), hence equality of system morphisms. Thus they jointly reflect isomorphisms. The jointly conservative exact-functor criteria reflect the zero composite, short exactness and finite-colimit preservation. This proves the stated ordinary result, including zero systems and empty complementary pieces.

theorem tower_ordinary_localization (b : Base l E) (o : Operations l E b)
    {Z U T : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) (a : U ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (complement : Set.range a = (Set.range i)ᶜ) :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (o.geometry i).push ∧
      ∀ M : S l E T,
        Mono ((o.openOp a).ordinaryAdjunction.counit.app M) ∧
        Epi ((o.geometry i).ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app M) ∧
        (ComposableArrows.mk₂ ((o.openOp a).ordinaryAdjunction.counit.app M)
          ((o.geometry i).ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app M)).Exact
